title: D-form harness response envelope
description: Wire contract for the envelope written to stdout by the per-language harnesses (java, python, cpp). Pinned from current reality (java Main.java, python main.py / _case_runner.py, cpp main.cpp).

harness_version.description: Harness protocol version. Bumped on wire breaks.

language.description: Language tag. (C stub does not emit.)

total_elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the whole batch as measured by the harness parent process.

results.description: Per-case verdicts. Order matches input.cases. May be shorter than cases only on harness panic (backend maps missing to Runtime Error).

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of this case, ms-truncated. Kept for backwards compat.

cpu_ms.description: CPU time (user+sys) the user code consumed, in ms. Excludes harness reflection / IPC overhead.

peak_memory_bytes.description: Per-case peak memory in bytes. Language-specific semantics: Java = sum of HEAP pool peaks after resetPeakUsage(); Python = ru_maxrss of per-case subprocess; C++ = getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss of forked child.

result.description: User's JSON-normalized return value on success; null on non-pass verdicts.

interrupted.description: true when the case was SIGKILLed (TLE / case-runner subprocess timeout). Absent on most other verdicts.

user_stdout.description: Captured user stdout during the case. Capped at 64 KiB; truncated marker appended.

user_stderr.description: Captured user stderr. Always emitted by every language (even when empty) for shape stability.
